opportunities.title: Main Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK-based organisations; individuals must have formal employment or contractual relationship with the host institution; projects led by organisations not based in the UK are not funded except in exceptional cases.
opportunities.summary: Research fund offering up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases) for projects addressing priority questions from the Foundation's Strategic Review. Two application deadlines per year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities; UK-based organisations are eligible.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges. One annual deadline in Autumn.
